title: Centrifugal Pumps - Stable and Unstable Flow
description: The characteristics of stable and unstable flow in centrifugal pumps. Understand the behavior differences between stable head-flow characteristics where differential head progressively falls with increasing flow rate, and unstable head-flow characteristics where differential head rises to a maximum before falling.

components.content:
## Stable Head-Flow Characteristic
The differential head (_h_) progressively falls with increasing flow rate (_q_). This creates a stable operating condition where the pump behavior is predictable and consistent.

## Unstable Head-Flow Characteristic
The differential head (_h_) rises to a maximum and then progressively falls with increasing flow rate (_q_). An unstable pump may start to oscillate between two possible combinations of head-flow, causing the flow rate to modulate and the pipeline to vibrate.

## Recommendations
It is recommended that centrifugal pumps are designed and operated under **stable conditions** to ensure reliable and safe operation.
